properties.site-address: Former Avenue Coking Works site, Derby Road, Wingerworth
properties.notes: This brownfield site is the central part of the larger Avenue Strategic Site which is a mixed-use redevelopment to comprise 13.4 ha of residential use providing 489 dwellings, 2.8 ha of commercial land for employment use, 1.8 ha of land for provision of a primary school, 0.4 ha of land for other community use and formal and informal play and recreation space.. The reserved matters approval is the first phase of re-development for 252 dwellings (16/00526/RM).. http://www.ne-derbyshire.gov.uk/index.php/your-council/document-library/local-plan-exam-library/03-supporting-docs-evidence-base/housing/2292-eb-hou6b-housing-sites-appendix-c/file
